depends_on.shift_history_requirement: Complete internal ledger integrity validation must pass before monotonic anchor comparison.

external_anchor.purpose: Detect rollback of the shift ledger to an older internally valid snapshot by comparing it with a separately persisted monotonic anchor state.
external_anchor.bootstrap: Allowed only when the ledger is empty and no anchor exists. A nonempty ledger cannot be retroactively blessed by creating a new anchor.
external_anchor.crash_boundary: If the ledger advances but the anchor write does not complete, the next operation fails closed as UNANCHORED_LEDGER_ADVANCE. This shadow code never auto-reconciles an unanchored advance because that could bless an untrusted fork.
external_anchor.trust_boundary: The code validates anchor structure/hash/domain binding, but it cannot prove that anchor storage is physically or cryptographically outside the ledger rollback domain. Production use requires a genuinely independent monotonic durability service or equivalent trusted storage primitive.

concurrency.writer_serialization: Atomic directory-creation lock is required around anchor-verified append and anchor advance.
concurrency.reason: Automatically stealing a stale-looking lock can create split-brain writers when time/liveness evidence is wrong.
concurrency.recovery: Abandoned lock removal requires external recovery/operator authority and is intentionally not implemented by this shadow module.

self_review_hardening: Initial anchor comparison inspected only ledger latest_seq/head_hash and could miss an internally tampered event/index if the stored head field was left unchanged.
Repaired in the same tranche by invoking the existing complete shift-registry reload integrity validator before every anchor comparison.
Writer lock now creates its parent directory but never automatically steals an existing lock.
regression_scope: anchored append advances ledger and anchor together
exact duplicate is NO_OP without anchor advance
whole-ledger rollback to older valid snapshot detected
internal event tamper rejected before anchor comparison
second writer blocked by atomic lock
successive anchor state binds previous anchor hash
next_unresolved_after_this_tranche: A real external monotonic durability provider/registry identity must replace the shadow durability-domain assertion before authoritative routing use.
Crash reconciliation requires an authenticated recovery receipt rather than automatic local blessing.
Shift-history policy calibration and paired performance non-regression remain TEST_REQUIRED.
Live v2/v2.1 still consume raw caller recent_shift_rate_ratio and are unchanged by this shadow tranche.
